description: A witch's head in profile facing left: a long crooked nose and pointed chin under a wide-brimmed pointed hat whose tip bends sharply back in a zigzag, with hair hanging down behind; hard to read.
A masked face from the front: two tall pointed mask fins sweeping up and outward from the temples, angry slanted eyes, and a mouth opening with a squared chin.
A woman's bust from the front: long hair framing the face and falling to the shoulders, a tiara band across the forehead, dot eyes and lips, and sloping shoulders.
An Xbox-style gamepad from the front: a wide body with flared grips, a ring thumbstick at the upper left, a plus-shaped button cluster at the upper right and a plus-shaped D-pad below centre.
An upright rectangular Xbox Series S console with a round vent near its top, and a controller with two round thumbsticks placed in front of it at the lower left.
A rectangular console in isometric view standing on its long edge: a large oval vent on the front face and two small port slots on the narrow side face.
A tall rectangular Xbox Series X console with a round vent at the top and a vertical slot line, with a controller with two round thumbsticks in front of it at the lower right.
A tall box-shaped console tower in isometric view with its top face visible, a round vent dot near the top of the right face and a vertical slot rising from its base.
A front-facing head with very large pointed ears spreading out horizontally, a wrinkled brow with heavy lines, half-closed eyes, a small chin and a collar line at the neck.
